plan.summary:
Refresh now rejects malformed refresh tokens before calling the server. The `maskToken` helper moves lower in `src/auth/tokens.ts` with no change to its code.

- `refresh` throws `Malformed refresh token` if the token does not match `/^[\w-]{20,}$/`.
- `maskToken` is moved, not changed.
plan.riskRationale: The change touches auth token handling. A strict regex could reject valid refresh tokens, for example tokens that contain characters outside `[\w-]`, such as dots. The change is small.
plan.storyArc: The PR adds a local format check so bad tokens never reach the server. The `maskToken` move is only code reordering.

noise.reason: Removes `maskToken` from the top of the file. Hunk-1 adds the same code lower down, so this is a move with no runtime effect.

topics.title: Reject malformed refresh tokens before the server call
topics.narrativeBrief: What does `refresh` do with a token that has a bad format? Check the regex `/^[\w-]{20,}$/`: it needs 20 or more word or hyphen characters. Check that the throw happens before `fetchTokens`. The writer should confirm that the `maskToken` lines in this hunk are only a move.
